summary: Join our Balanced Scorecard training to elevate your strategy management expertise. Discover tools to measure performance and enhance decision-making.
lede: Balanced Scorecard training helps experienced strategy and performance professionals connect strategic priorities with measurable objectives and accountable initiatives. It covers strategy mapping, SWOT and PESTLE analysis, KPI selection and target setting, initiative prioritization, and performance reviews to identify corrective action. Participants practise linking strategic risks to objectives and presenting scorecard evidence for leadership decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced professionals who shape, coordinate, measure, or govern strategy management and Balanced Scorecard execution. It suits cross-functional leaders who already work with strategic plans, performance data, business cases, or transformation portfolios.
modules: Balanced Scorecard Architecture and Strategy Maps
KPI Design, Data Quality, and Measurement
prerequisites: You should have practical experience with strategic planning, business performance reporting, portfolio governance, or organizational transformation. Familiarity with financial plans, operational KPIs, risk registers, and executive reporting will help you contribute effectively. No programming is required. Advanced digital topics such as AI-assisted trend analysis and dashboard automation are taught at an operational application level, while software engineering and enterprise platform implementation remain outside scope. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the templates during exercises, although no specialist software installation is required.
